live_evidence.interpretation: KS D ISO 9227 was established 2003-12-26 (notification 2003-1673) as Korea's identical (IDT) adoption of ISO 9227:1990, then ABOLISHED 2005-12-28 (notification 2005-0989) with the stated reason 'KSD9502와 규격중복' (duplicate/overlapping with KS D 9502). The registry's own 대체 표준 (replacement-standard) field is empty ('no replacement standard on file'), meaning the abolition was a straight repeal-in-favor-of-the-existing-KS-D-9502-scope, not a renumbering. The standard has carried NO current legal text for approximately 21 years (2005-12-28 to snapshot date 2026-08-17).
